We need to determine charges based on facts. Facts: Defendant broke into victim's residence, attempted theft but did not obtain property. That's burglary/robbery? In Chinese criminal law, "盗窃" (theft) includes burglary. Since no property obtained, it's theft attempt (未遂). So charge is 盗窃 (theft). Also maybe "入室盗窃" is a specific form but still under theft. No other conduct. So single charge: 盗窃.
